prompt.prompt_text:
You are a remediation agent executing the next Hypergenium roadmap step for this repo.

Context (source of truth)
- Roadmap: hgm-infra/planning/lift-10of10-roadmap.md (Rubric v0.1.0)
- Rubric: hgm-infra/planning/lift-10of10-rubric.md
- Evidence plan: hgm-infra/planning/lift-evidence-plan.md
- Threat model: hgm-infra/planning/lift-threat-model.md (THR-1: secret leakage via logs)
- Deterministic verifier entrypoint: bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh
- COM-6 checker: go run ./hgm-infra/verifiers/cmd/com6-logging-standards-check
- Current failure evidence: hgm-infra/evidence/COM-6-output.log and hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json

Why this is the next step
- The latest rubric report is overall FAIL due to COM-6 failing.
- COM-6 is an anti-drift / operational safety control tied to THR-1 (preventing accidental secret leakage via uncontrolled logging/output).
- The COM-6 verifier is already implemented and deterministically identifies violations; the remaining work is remediation in production code.

Goal (definition of done)
1) COM-6 must be PASS:
   - go run ./hgm-infra/verifiers/cmd/com6-logging-standards-check exits 0 and reports no violations.
   - bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh shows COM-6 = PASS in hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json.
2) Evidence is refreshed under hgm-infra/evidence/:
   - hgm-infra/evidence/COM-6-output.log (must show PASS / no violations)
   - hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json
3) A progress note is created:
   - hgm-infra/evidence/roadmap-progress-M3-COM-6-REM-1.md

COM-6 policy (as enforced by the deterministic verifier)
- Scope: Go files under pkg/** and cmd/**
- Ignore: *_test.go
- Forbidden (must eliminate everywhere in-scope):
  - fmt.Print / fmt.Printf / fmt.Println
  - log.Print / log.Printf / log.Println / log.Fatal* / log.Panic*
  - builtin println
  - import of the standard library package "log" (the checker flags the import itself)

Strict guardrails (anti-drift / scope control)
- Do NOT modify anything under hgm-infra/verifiers/** in this step (no changing the checker to “make it pass”).
- Do NOT weaken or change rubric requirements (no dilution).
- Do NOT change toolchain pins, go.mod/go.sum, .golangci.yml, or .github/workflows/*.
- Allowed code changes are limited to ONLY what is necessary to eliminate COM-6 violations, and ONLY in:
  - pkg/**
  - cmd/**
- Do NOT perform unrelated refactors.
- Do NOT introduce new ways of printing secrets/tokens/CHD-derived data. Prefer sanitized/structured logging when feasible.

Practical remediation strategy (keep it mechanical and safe)
You will likely see many violations (current evidence shows hundreds). Fix them systematically while minimizing behavioral risk.

1) Use the COM-6 checker output as your authoritative TODO list
- Run:
  - go run ./hgm-infra/verifiers/cmd/com6-logging-standards-check
- Treat its output as the exact set of files/lines to remediate.
- Re-run the checker frequently to ensure the violation count is going down.

2) Replace fmt.Print*/Printf/Println (recommended patterns)
A) For user-facing CLI output (common under pkg/cli/**)
- Replace forbidden calls with explicit-writer variants (these are NOT prohibited by the COM-6 checker):
  - fmt.Printf(...)   -> fmt.Fprintf(os.Stdout, ...)
  - fmt.Println(...)  -> fmt.Fprintln(os.Stdout, ...)
  - fmt.Print(...)    -> fmt.Fprint(os.Stdout, ...)
- For warnings/errors intended for the user:
  - use os.Stderr with fmt.Fprint/Fprintf/Fprintln
- Add import "os" where needed.
- Keep the message text and formatting stable (avoid changing user-visible output unless absolutely required).

B) For non-CLI packages (libraries / runtime behavior)
- Prefer removing ad-hoc printing entirely (return errors upward instead), OR
- If a structured logger is safe to use without causing import cycles, prefer structured logging:
  - If safe: use github.com/pay-theory/lift/pkg/logger (global singleton) and log via logger.GetLiftLogger().Info/Warn/Error.
  - Be careful about logging sensitive fields. If you log structured fields that may contain secrets/user data, sanitize them first (e.g., logger.SanitizeLogFields(fields)).

3) Remove standard library "log" imports and replace log.* usage
- The checker flags importing "log" as a violation even if unused. Remove it.
- Replace log.Printf/log.Println etc with one of:
  - Structured logger calls (preferred when safe), or
  - Error returns / propagated errors (preferred for libraries), or
  - Explicit-writer output fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, ...) (only when you cannot safely wire a structured logger and the output is truly necessary).

4) Replace builtin println
- Replace println(...) with fmt.Fprintln(os.Stdout, ...) or fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, ...) as appropriate.

5) Format + regressions
- Run gofmt on changed files.
- Run make test to ensure unit tests remain green.

Verification + evidence refresh (required)
1) Run:
   - make test
2) Run:
   - bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh
3) Confirm in hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json:
   - COM-6 status is PASS
4) Ensure evidence files were refreshed:
   - hgm-infra/evidence/COM-6-output.log
   - hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json

Progress note (required)
- Create: hgm-infra/evidence/roadmap-progress-M3-COM-6-REM-1.md
- Include:
  - Timestamp
  - Baseline violation count and final violation count (from the COM-6 checker output)
  - Summary of what kinds of changes you made (e.g., “Converted fmt.Printf -> fmt.Fprintf(os.Stdout, ...) in pkg/cli/*”, “Removed stdlib log imports in pkg/security/*”)
  - Any sensitive-logging decisions (e.g., places where you intentionally avoided logging bodies/tokens)
  - Evidence pointers:
    - hgm-infra/evidence/COM-6-output.log
    - hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json

Stop conditions (do not expand scope)
- If eliminating a violation would require edits outside pkg/** or cmd/**, STOP and write the blocker into the progress note instead of broadening scope.
- If you suspect the COM-6 policy is incorrect, do NOT change it in this step; record concerns in the progress note and propose a follow-up planning step.
prompt.step_description: Remediate COM-6 by removing all forbidden direct logging primitives (fmt.Print*/log.*/println and stdlib log imports) from in-scope production code (pkg/**, cmd/**) so the deterministic COM-6 verifier passes; then refresh rubric evidence and record a progress note under hgm-infra/.
